descriptionChirho: Aramaic feminine noun קִרְיָה (qiryah) meaning 'city' or 'town,' cognate with Hebrew קִרְיָה. Used both in absolute/construct state ('city,' 'city of') and with prepositions ('in city of'). Eng 'city / and city / in city of,' Spa 'ciudad / en ciudad de,' Hin 'नगर / नगरों में,' Arb 'الْمَدِينَةُ / فِي مُدُنِ,' Kor '성읍,' Swa 'mji / katika mji.' The prepositional form does not represent a distinct sense; all occurrences refer to the same concept of an inhabited urban settlement.
